newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.62/63 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.62/63 per dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.6200/6350 on Friday, unchanged from the opening levels, in a day of remarkable stability, dealers said.
"It was the range throughout the day," said the chief forex dealer at a state-run bank. "It was the high as well as low level." He said the supply and demand were evenly matched.
Most of the day's deals were at 35.6250, dealers said. They said the Reserve Bank of India bought dollars at this level.

Paying pressure, partly from domestic financial institutions, pushed up the forward dollar premia, dealers said. The six month annualised premium closed at 8.75 percent, up from Thursday's closing of 8.25 percent.
